messages.subject: Urgent: Error in mirt?
parts:
Hi Phil,

I just rerun my old multidimensional partial credit model, which worked fine last time, but now it gave me an error message:

> model <- mirt.model('
+                     F1 = 1-30
+                     F2 = 36-48
+                     F3 = 49-57
+                     F4 = 31-35
+                     COV = F1*F2*F3*F4,F1*F1, F2*F2, F3*F3, F4*F4')
> altmod1 <- mirt(data1,model,itemtype = 'Rasch',method='MHRM')
Stage 3 = 18, LL = -249914.5, AR(0.65) = [0.11], gam = 0.0212, Max-Change = 0.0006

Calculating log-likelihood...
Error in serialize(data, node$con) : error writing to connection

Could you advise why this is happening?

many thanks,

Diah

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Urgent: Error in mirt?
parts:
It looks like something went wrong in R's parallel package. I've noticed that this happens from time to time. Just restarting R and rerunning the analysis should fix the problem. Cheers.

Phil
